$comment: Sound-review candidates for the s2 brief. Rendered by sound-review/render.ts. Review artifacts only — excluded from the game bundle. WAV paths are relative to this file.

slots.label: Rock Chip
slots.context: Per-tick mining laser hit while chipping a rock — fires rapidly, must read as a stream

candidates.character: abrasive cutting head, dry grit
blunt pressure bite, sub weight
induction tick, short metal ring

slots.label: Hull Hit
slots.context: A weapon shot bites an enemy ship/turret/shield/core.

candidates.character: coil bite on plate, hard and dry
mass driver round, weight behind it
particle shear, thin and ionised

slots.label: Rock Crack Stage
slots.context: A rock advances one of its three crack stages

candidates.character: fracture step, splintering grains
deep stone shear, pressure released
crystalline shear, ringing shards

slots.label: Rock Burst + Ore Payout
slots.context: A rock breaks apart entirely and pays out ore

candidates.character: shell fracture, debris rattle, ore lifting out
pressure burst, dust settling, ore on the wave
shattered plate, shards ringing out

slots.label: Ore Collect
slots.context: A loose ore chunk is tractored in

candidates.character: a prize: two notes, rising a fifth
a handful of chips into the tray
a breath, nothing struck
the sound that ships today (A/B)

slots.label: Cargo Hold Full
slots.context: Cargo hold reaches capacity — signals 'fly home'

candidates.character: hopper at its stop, twice, dry
seal taking all it can, twice
load cell reading out, two bands
it says so twice and stops

slots.label: Turret Fire
slots.context: Your turret or ship fires a shot.

candidates.character: a report: crack, thump, action
a discharge: beam falling, ion hiss
a launch: magnetic snap and weight
the sound that ships today (A/B)

slots.label: Impact — Hull
slots.context: A shot lands on an enemy ship. Thin plate over a body that is moving — the only one of the four that RINGS.

candidates.character: a dent: plate deforming, then ringing
spall: debris comes off the plate
a punch-through, and the hollow behind it
armour doing its job: damped, almost no ring

slots.label: Impact — Rock
slots.context: A shot bites stone. Dry and low, and NOTHING rings — a rock that rings is a bell somebody painted grey.

candidates.character: a bite: granular cutting, no tone
mass: pressure into stone, no grit
shatter: chips leaving the face
dead stop: the round just ends

slots.label: Impact — Shield
slots.context: A shot stopped by a live bubble. The round never reached anything solid, and THAT is the whole information.

candidates.character: stopped short: the contact is cut off
swallowed: a corner closing over it
static: it ionises, with no body at all
a glance: it slides off and away

slots.label: Impact — Station
slots.context: A shot on anchored metal: a turret, a radar satellite, or the bare core. The darkest of the four — mass that does not move.

candidates.character: anchored: a thud that goes nowhere
bulkhead: a big damped panel
structure: the hit travels into the frame
a ricochet off armour, into a room

slots.label: Shield Hit
slots.context: A shield absorbs a hit — struck bell, not broken.

candidates.character: deflection: it skids off, ring spreading
absorption: swallowed, a low bloom
arc: sparks over a ringing bubble
flex: the surface bends and settles

slots.label: Shield Down
slots.context: A shield's bubble fails and falls.

candidates.character: lattice unwinding, band walking down
vent to vacuum, air then nothing
capacitor discharging, room behind
damped drop, one stage, no drama

slots.label: Core Hit
slots.context: A home core takes damage. SERIOUS — low, drops, no sparkle.

candidates.character: containment knock, deep and short
coolant surge under the hit
load transferring through the frame
one dull mass, nothing after it

slots.label: Turret Destroyed
slots.context: A turret is destroyed.

candidates.character: rail mount letting go, dry
pressure vessel emptying out
cell arcing out, damped metal
it stops working, and drops

slots.label: Ship Explosion
slots.context: A ship blows up — a pressure failure, over quickly. No sparkle (§4.7).

candidates.character: ion wash, exhaust torn open
inertial failure, weight going out
containment failing, room answering
one failure, over immediately

slots.label: Ship Spawn
slots.context: A ship arrives on the field

candidates.character: ion wash settling into place
mass arriving and seating
containment closing on the hull
clamps release, and it is there

slots.label: Spawn Protection Pulse
slots.context: Quiet repeating tick during 10s of spawn protection

candidates.character: field grain, soft and particulate
a held-pressure pip, low
the field skin, one damped band
barely a sound, a breath of it

slots.label: Thruster Loop
slots.context: Held engine note while the throttle is open (loops continuously)

candidates.character: breath: air only, no floor
pressure: felt, not heard
one warm band, nothing to beat
almost nothing, the floor of the slot

slots.label: Build Placed
slots.context: A turret/build is placed and starts building — ore spent, a latch not a fanfare.

candidates.character: clamp bites, a drive spins up
pressure takes, the line still loaded
it seats, then the head starts working
one contact, and a bus comes up

slots.label: Build Complete
slots.context: A paid-for defence finishes building — a rising confirmation.

candidates.character: three stepper contacts, rising, dry
system coming up to pressure
two welds, the second holding
done: one seated contact

slots.label: Repair Tick
slots.context: A soft tick as a repair purchase is applied to a structure.

candidates.character: stepper pip, one small travel
sealant taking, low and short
spot weld, quenched at once
the quietest tick that still reads

slots.label: Bank Ore
slots.context: Ore is deposited into your station's store.

candidates.character: the two notes, with coins under them
counted, then the drawer takes it
the second note lands in the tray
the sound that ships today (A/B)

slots.label: Upgrade Bought
slots.context: An upgrade is purchased from the wheel.

candidates.character: the same three notes, thinner
two notes, the triad implied
the three notes, receding
the sound that ships today (A/B)

slots.label: Wave Arrive
slots.context: An asteroid wave arrives, field closes in — two low foghorn notes.

candidates.character: two horns with tectonic weight under them
two air-driven horns, no tone edge
two bands inside a hull, room behind
the two notes, and nothing else

slots.label: Collapse Begin
slots.context: The collapse phase begins — entropy arriving; low rumble and drone, slow.

candidates.character: tectonic shift, weight moving slowly
atmosphere leaving, a long draw
the hull resonating, strain rising
one long fall, nothing added

slots.label: MiningStation Death
slots.context: A station dies (GDD §4.7) — the most serious sound in the game; then three seconds of silence.

candidates.character: detonation: a blast front, then the mass
breach: a crack, then everything leaving
blast, and then the structure falls
one concussion, and the room

slots.label: Match End — Win
slots.context: You won. Lands AFTER the three seconds of quiet, ahead of the music sting. Arrival, never a fanfare.

candidates.character: direction: two notes rising a fifth
the room: a chord opening upward
pressure: the corner opens, no melody
the stamp: one note, and it's over

slots.label: Match End — Loss
slots.context: You lost. The same gesture as the win, inverted — and never a joke: the home that just died is the one serious thing (§4.7).

candidates.character: direction: two notes falling a fifth
the room: a chord closing downward
pressure: the corner shuts, no melody
the stamp: one low note, and nothing

slots.label: Home Alarm
slots.context: Your home is under attack (GDD §2.2) — a mechanic, not music; sounded once per engagement.

candidates.character: announcement: two warm horn tones
pressure horn: tone low, top is breath
down a corridor: the notes, and the room
two low pulses, and that is all

slots.label: Ambient Bed
slots.context: The constant background loop during ordinary play — must vanish into the background over ~15 minutes.

candidates.character: far hull, air with no low end
a slow tide, only the filters move
a low room with a slow pulse
one slow breath, and no floor at all

slots.fourthOption: None of the three: ship the bed OFF by default, with a settings toggle for anyone who wants it. It is item 3 on the GDD §4.9 cut list and nothing else in the mix depends on it, so this is a legitimate verdict rather than a failure — a bed nobody notices and a bed that is absent are close cousins, and one of them cannot annoy anybody. Reply `ambient: off` to take it.

slots.label: Music Bed — Calm
slots.context: Calm layer of the adaptive soundtrack — loops under mining.

candidates.character: an A-minor triad, warm and breathing
root and fifth, open, no third
the triad, with one voice an octave up
two voices and a sub, barely there

slots.label: Music Pulse — Rising Tension
slots.context: Tension layer — fades in as waves rise.

candidates.character: a bass line: root and fifth, alternating
the root pulsing under a held third
a two-note rise, A to C and back
a pedal, with the fifth answering once

slots.label: Music Theme — Siege
slots.context: Full theme — plays during a siege.

candidates.character: four chords, one a second, no melody
a bass that walks under a held chord
two chords breathing, one voice stepping
a pedal, and one three-note answer

slots.label: Music Dread — Collapse
slots.context: Collapse layer — replaces the others as entropy arrives.

candidates.character: a tritone, low enough to be pressure
a pedal, with a voice creeping up
the clash, with a heartbeat under it
one deep tone, the room emptying

slots.label: Victory Sting
slots.context: Match won (after the three-second quiet) — one-shot, a short rising resolution.

candidates.character: two notes, a fifth, opening
one chord, struck and opening
the top note first, the floor after
the sound that ships today (A/B)

slots.label: Defeat Sting
slots.context: Match lost (after the three-second quiet) — one-shot, falling minor phrase that settles low.

candidates.character: two notes, then a breath that stops
one note sinking, no melody at all
the phrase as one falling chord
the sound that ships today (A/B)

slots.label: Press Tick
slots.context: A wheel wedge / menu control was pressed — the lightest possible click, heard dozens of times a match.

candidates.character: the pane, thinner: two partials at A♭6
the pane an octave up, at A♭7
fingertip first, then the pane
the full pane, three partials, quietest

slots.label: Purchase Confirm
slots.context: A purchase or repair committed — a rising two-beat 'done'.

candidates.character: two capacitive contacts, rising
the buy landing, damped and low
two bands, a fourth apart
done, in one contact

slots.label: Reject Buzz
slots.context: A buy the player can't afford. The sound of NO: flat, short, unmistakable, and never funny.

candidates.character: the glass, refused: a minor second struck at once
a bar dropping: the shop shuts
the buzzer, done properly: one flat band, cut
dead: the signal is cut mid-word

slots.label: Deposit Tick
slots.context: One ore chunk settling into the bank on a deposit flight — soft & falling, one tick per chunk.

candidates.character: a stepper contact, very small
a vacuum take, no edge on it
a quenched band, one partial
air moving, and a chunk arriving

slots.label: Respawn Beep
slots.context: A tick of the respawn countdown — one clean mid beep a second, deliberately plain, a clock.

candidates.character: escapement contact, dry
a seated pip, weight behind it
one narrow band, instrument-clean
a relay closing, and nothing else

slots.label: Respawn Go
slots.context: Respawn launch — the ship back on the field, brighter & a step up from the countdown beeps.

candidates.character: ion wash releasing, dry top
catapult mass, pressure leaving
containment opening, band clearing
launch clamps let go, once

slots.label: Minimap Ping
slots.context: The minimap toggle (the ping mechanic itself was cut) — it locates; it must never read as an alarm.

candidates.character: a swept return through dust
a soft pulse going out and back
one band opening a map
a display coming up, barely

slots.label: XP Tick
slots.context: One step of the end-of-match count-up — dozens in five seconds, every match. If it is interesting, it is wrong.

candidates.character: a counter contact, dry grit
a damped pip, felt not heard
one narrow band, machine-clean

slots.label: XP Bar Fill
slots.context: The bed under the level bar filling — starts and ends with the bar, and ducks under a level-up landing on it.

candidates.character: particulate fill, poured in
a low bed under pressure
an induction hum, taking charge

slots.label: Level Up
slots.context: The bar completed and the level ticked over — the one moment in the beat allowed to be a reward. Arrival, not fanfare.

candidates.character: a lock engaging, mass seating hard
a drive coming online, opening
a vault seating, contacts in a room

slots.label: XP Settle
slots.context: Earned XP lands and is yours — the number has stopped moving and the total is final. Small and warm: the arrival of something already won.

candidates.character: a measure poured into a cell, topping off
a credit recorded, two damped partials
an uptake, the corner opening as it takes
a small bright prize over a warm body
